card.name: Linking words in teen risk-behavior lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (about, or, as, for, by, in) in web text about teenagers, peer pressure and risky behavior such as drinking, drugs or violent media. It fires where a risky behavior or peer influence is about to be named.

modes.label: Lists of risky behaviors
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'as' joins or introduces risky acts like drinking, drugs or smoking in teen-focused text.
modes.example: - Drinking alcohol<< or>> using drugs or tobacco.

modes.label: Teen life and peer pressure
modes.description: A linking word appears in a sentence about what teens do or are pushed to do by friends.
modes.example: teens with an ADHD prescription are sometimes pressured<< by>> friends to share some of their pills

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about peers, youth, music, nightclubs and violence.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in articles about teens and risky behavior, just before peers or the risky activity is named.
